title: A warmer start with safer backup choices

changes.title: Welcome to Nexus
changes.detail: New users can see what Nexus does, learn how browser storage works, and choose to start fresh or restore a backup.

changes.title: Backup preview before restoration
changes.detail: Review counts and confirm before restoring; onboarding restoration is blocked when existing records are detected.

dataImpact: No automatic migration. An explicit, confirmed restore can replace the empty setup after preserving its previous storage value.
limitations: Calculator PR #67 is held pending safety validation.
Published web-build parity and physical iPhone acceptance remain unverified.
